name: Isperia
description: Isperia is the sphinx guildmaster of the Azorius Senate on Ravnica, known for proposing cooperation among the guilds and for being petrified by Vraska.

timeline.summary: Isperia lifts the Forum's rigid magical controls, reviving it as an open civic space.
timeline.quote: Isperia — then the Azorius guildmaster — lifted the rigid magical controls over the Forum.

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies and kills Isperia under Bolas' orders.
timeline.quote: She was petrified and killed by Vraska , leader of the Golgari Swarm , under Bolas' orders.

citation.text: "Sphinx", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa warns Isperia that the Selesnya are gathering armies.
timeline.quote: The Selesnya are gathering armies.

citation.text: Horncaller's Chant (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A sphinx warns Isperia of danger on the horizon.
timeline.quote: Danger is on the horizon.

citation.text: Sphinx of the Chimes (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Leonos II becomes Arbiter and Isperia reluctantly becomes Azorius guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Leonos II became the Arbiter of the Azorius Senate

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Return to Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia is convinced to lead the Azorius as crime and chaos grow without the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Isperia decided her service was needed enough to trump her preferences.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "Supreme Judge Isperia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Prahv is built once popular support grows and Isperia accepts leadership of the guild.
timeline.quote: Only once popular support built up and Isperia accepted the leadership of the guild did the gears of reconstruction begin to turn.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "New Prahv, the Azorius Guildhall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia decrees the magic lifted from the Forum of Azor, reviving it as a chaotic public space.
timeline.quote: Isperia decreed that the magic be lifted from the Forum

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3", section "Forum of Azor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia is chosen to run the maze for the Azorius and arrests Jace at the Azorius Guildgate.
timeline.quote: Lavinia took the opportunity to, at last, arrest Jace

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia gathers the guilds in a climate of suspicion to propose cooperation.
timeline.quote: Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

citation.text: Guild Summit (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia attends the guild summit and sees it dissolve after Isperia's murder, then joins Ral's alliance.
timeline.quote: She witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Guild Summit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia falls victim to Vraska and is replaced by Dovin Baan, who introduces spy thopters and precognitive arrests.
timeline.quote: Isperia fell victim to Vraska and was replaced by the planeswalker Dovin Baan .

citation.text: "Azorius Senate", section "Guilds of Ravnica storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Isperia and flees to Ixalan to escape Ral Zarek, leaving the Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.
timeline.quote: After Vraska killed Isperia , she planeswalked to Ixalan to escape from being killed by Ral Zarek leaving the various Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lavinia refuses to recognize Dovin Baan's authority after Vraska assassinates Isperia and leads a rebel faction.
timeline.quote: she also refused to acknowledge Dovin Baan 's authority

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Isperia, fulfilling Bolas's demands and her personal revenge, and the guilds' cooperation collapses.
timeline.quote: Vraska petrified the sphinx.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Interlocus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius Senate orders a mass arrest of Golgari and Vraska is imprisoned.
timeline.quote: issued a writ of mass arrest for any people caught bearing allegiance to the Golgari

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Persecuted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Isperia after the guild summit.
timeline.quote: Vraska killed Isperia after the guild summit as payback for the suffering of her youth

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Vraska kills Isperia, Dovin becomes Azorius guildmaster and introduces spy thopters and precognitive arrests.
timeline.quote: When Isperia was killed by Vraska , Dovin took over as guildmaster

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara attends the guild summit for the Conclave and witnesses its dissolution after Isperia's murder.
timeline.quote: witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Teysa witness the guild summit's dissolution after Isperia's murder.
timeline.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia .

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies the sphinx Isperia at the guild summit, shattering hopes for cooperation.
timeline.quote: Vraska petrified the sphinx.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Guild summit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Isperia, causing the guild summit to fail.
timeline.quote: That night, Vraska killed Isperia , causing the summit to fail.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Identity revealed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Isperia in a fit of rage at the guild summit, breaking down negotiations and making Dovin the Azorius guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Vraska kills Isperia in a fit of rage

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
timeline.quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska turned Isperia to stone at the Azorius Senate House.
timeline.quote: This was where Vraska turned Isperia to stone.

citation.text: "Precinct Two", section "Neighborhoods and Landmarks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Isperia's assassination Ferzhin shows leadership and joins a council of war.
timeline.quote: Ferzhin demonstrated leadership in the ensuing chaos

citation.text: "Ferzhin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After killing Isperia, Vraska flees to High and Dry and spends the start of the War of the Spark there.
timeline.quote: After killing Isperia , Vraska fled to High and Dry to recuperate.

citation.text: "High and Dry", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a judge, Isperia issued a writ of mass arrest of Golgari members, and Vraska was apprehended.
timeline.quote: Vraska was amongst those apprehended

citation.text: "Isperia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia replaced Augustin IV as guildmaster after years of convincing.

citation.text: "Isperia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrified Isperia after the first day of the guild summit; Dovin Baan replaced her.

citation.text: "Isperia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Isperia's petrified form sank into the Undercity and began to be reclaimed.
timeline.quote: Isperia's petrified form sank into the Undercity

citation.text: "Isperia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "New Prahv", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
